    Args:
        x: A numpy array representing observations of current position.
        v: A numpy array representing observations of velocity.
        params: Array of numeric constants or parameters to be optimized

    Return:
        A numpy array representing acceleration as the result of applying the mathematical function to the inputs.
    """
    """
    Improved version of `equation_v0`.
    Args: 
        x: Sizeable representation of observational position.
        v: Velocity Observations.
        params: Tuple Array of numeric substrates or substrate-to-be optimized. 
            [External Drive Rate, Damping Constant, Spring Constant, Mass Constant, Driving Force Correction rate, Position Adjustment Correction].
    Returns:
        Applicable Observaion Correction Vectors of Acceleration Sums.
    """

    damping_const = params[1]
    spring_constant = params[2]
